summary: Motor vehicle accident compensation appeal; 7-year-old pedestrian hit on zebra crossing; permanent 75% disability with moderate mental retardation; I.Q. 41, social Q. 43; subarachnoid haemorrhage, femur fracture; loss of earning capacity, marriage prospects; attendant charges miscalculated at minimum wage; High Court enhanced compensation by Rs.5,60,000/- but failed to adjust for full-time care needs; pain/suffering and future treatment under-compensated; appeal allowed for further adjudication on quantum.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; remanded to High Court for re-determination of compensation amounts for attendant charges, pain/suffering and future treatment based on evidence of permanent disability and full-time care requirements.
